scope: Isolated POC only. One public MCP exec with dtw JS helper. User-selected disposable Obsidian main window, read-only AX observations, no foreground activation, pointer or keyboard dispatch.

problem.unfiltered_outline: Two Obsidian windows each reached the native 24 KiB cumulative ax_output_limit after two pages: 80 and 79 unique Refs, truncated true, no continuation, complete false. No zero-match conclusion was drawn.
problem.targeted_locator: An exact 新建笔记 name lookup within the one selected main-window Ref returned exactly one control with complete clean coverage.

implementation.api: dtw.index(ob), dtw.disclose(ob,{fields,max_items,refresh}) and dtw.ref(display_id) in per-Session QuickJS state, no second MCP tool
implementation.native_receipts: Unchanged and retained by execution ID; dtw.disclose only projects model-facing print data.
implementation.behavior: Ref and field signature cache bounded to 512 Refs per Session; strips volatile fact sampled_at from comparison and displayed facts; window-scoped short display IDs (e.g. W2/R1) resolve to full internal Ref; first disclosure gives selected fields, repeat returns zero items, richer request emits only undisclosed capabilities. Explicit refresh re-emits selected facts. Native epoch change clears aliases without reusing window numbers in that Session.
implementation.region: Two real Obsidian AXWindow bounds were indexed. The exact New Note control had bounds but no object.window property; its clean single-window query scope safely supplied the owning window for a geometry-only area_hint=top. The heuristic does not claim semantic sidebar/main/popup identity.
implementation.limits: Requires a targeted native observe query. A broad native scan still stops at its native output cap. Arbitrary script print can still duplicate text across calls. MCP printed facts are in structuredContent once; text carries execution/status/error, not the same AX node. Byte sizes are not token or cost savings.

verification.synthetic_contract_test: TestDiscloseOnlyChangedFieldsPerSession passed: partial coverage retained, same-Session repeat suppressed, added and changed fields emitted, explicit refresh works, peer Session independent, two windows get W1/R1 and W2/R1, geometry bands left/main, stale epoch alias and foreign Session alias refused.
verification.real_app_test: TestSelectedRealAppProgressiveDisclosure passed in one official Go MCP Session across three exec calls: complete clean exact lookup, model-facing item counts 1/0/1; first item W2/R1 with area_hint=top and internal dtw.ref roundtrip; third item only adds capabilities, no repeated name; printed node absent from MCP text.
verification.measurement_note: Same fixed three-call real-App content comparison. Short text contains only status and execution IDs; structuredContent holds printed facts. Model billing tokens were not remeasured and no token saving percentage is inferred.

gate: Progressive model-facing disclosure on real Obsidian passed as an isolated POC slice. Full B02 remains partial due to native AX cap/dirty/stale and Windows continuation; product phase gate remains closed.
